Greek theo- is the independently documented combining form meaning god; the frozen educational source mislabels its original theo/thei form as the. American Heritage explicitly traces heterosis via Greek heterosis/heteroiosis to heteros different and lists heterotic as its adjective. Thus hetero is a valid family retrieval, with no claim that the o must be uniquely assigned to one component. Heterotic is also used for hybrid string theories.
